composite_targets.condition: Govern, research, choose direction, and produce approved requirements and plans without implementation.
Turn approved requirements into experience and architecture contracts, bounded implementation, independent verification, performance evidence, and local release readiness.
Package and preflight a verified change, perform only separately authorized remote actions, then observe production read-only.
Observe and investigate production, coordinate or separately authorize recovery, then produce evidence-linked learning.
Explicit end-to-end product lifecycle across all fourteen mandatory stages, with tool runtime support inserted only when a selected owner is blocked.

fallback.reason: ambiguous authority, scope, lifecycle stage, or multi-domain request

gates: never activate a remote or local-system step from routing alone
preserve all human checkpoints and invalidation
router does not execute target work
safety_overrides: missing customer, proprietary, recorded, or external-Judge governance returns needs-input or blocked
review plus repair splits identities and requires human repair authorization
observation plus rollback splits identities and requires fresh rollback authorization
remote, external-session, or local-system action without fresh per-action authorization routes to readiness or stops
one remote authorization never propagates to a later remote action
ambiguous multi-domain intent routes to governance intake instead of full lifecycle

specialized_targets.condition: explicit complete UI design, implementation, rendered review, and human-owned release recommendation

stage_targets.condition: authority, context, risk, data governance, or routing must be bounded
validated discovery, research, market, system, or evidence collection is required
evidence-backed alternatives, prioritization, positioning, or strategic choice is required
approved direction needs requirements, acceptance, implementation planning, or plan review
user-facing flow, visual system, interaction, accessibility, prototype, or rendered review is required
technical boundaries, data/API, authorization, secrets, AI architecture, or security review is required
authorized source implementation, repair, integration, or developer self-check is required
independent tests, QA, review, compliance, regression, or completion evidence is required
performance, resilience, determinism, benchmark, or reliability evidence is required
verified change needs local packaging, documentation, delivery preflight, or merge/deploy readiness
one explicitly authorized remote repository, provider, deployment, or configuration action is requested
a deployed change or production baseline needs read-only observation, canary, alerts, or health evidence
production failure requires investigation, coordination, or one separately authorized recovery action
outcomes, feedback, retrospective, adoption, or validated learning must feed the next lifecycle pass
a selected owner is blocked by a local tool, browser, artifact, memory, auth, or workflow-runtime prerequisite
